## Key identifiers and corrections: the hosts, buckets, schemas, files and labels currently in use. If a value was corrected, give the current value and mark the old value as superseded, do not use.

- Webhook target: `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`; customers currently receive HTTP 400 due to signature verification failure.
- CI label: `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is superseded.
- Avatar migration: source `/srv/app/avatars`; production bucket `cdn-prod-user-avatars`; manifest `/var/tmp/avatars.tsv`; SQL `sql/update_avatar_batch_0001.sql`; archive `snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz`; procedure `avatar-cdn-batched-migration`.
- Sandbox credentials: `ledgerly_sbx` prefix, configured in `settings/vendor_sbx.toml`; environment-variable configuration is superseded.
- Release smoke testing: post rendered notes in `#ledgerly-releases` using `ledgerly-release-notes-v3`.
- PDF files: `ledgerly/billing/pdf.py`; tests `tests/test_invoice_pdf.py`; shared money helper `ledgerly/billing/money.py`.
- Do not add the ruled-out `invoices(customer_id, created_at)` covering index.

## Recent work: a short narrative of what was done recently and what is still relevant.

Invoice PDF changes are in progress: negative credit lines now render, currency formatting uses `format_money()` with locale grouping, and page-height calculations use `_row_height(points)`. A long-invoice regression test initially produced 3 pages instead of 2; header reservation was corrected, and `tests/test_invoice_pdf.py` now passes with `14 passed, 1 skipped`. The broader billing suite passed with `83 passed, 4 skipped`. Existing golden PDF comparisons remained byte-stable. Visual comparison of three generated PDFs remains useful.

The current operator priority is fixing Stripe webhook signature verification in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`; no implementation for that fix has been recorded yet. Separately, `ledgerly/models.py` was migrated from `declarative_base()` to SQLAlchemy 2.0 `DeclarativeBase`; the full baseline before that edit was `148 passed, 2 skipped`.

- CI runner label: `ci-runner-small`.

- Procedure: `avatar-cdn-batched-migration`; only step 1 has run, with 18,432 `.png`/`.jpg` files found.

## Recent work: a short narrative of what was done recently and what is still relevant.

Implemented and tested invoice pagination, including count queries, bounded query parameters, and empty-page behavior. Ruff and whitespace checks pass. Invoice API, service, pagination, and report tests passed: 18 billing tests and 18 report tests, with the report suite completing successfully. The report investigation found a likely N+1 query pattern in `ledgerly/reports/invoice_summary.py`; no eager-loading changes have been made yet. The avatar migration has only completed its source/database check. Before any staging smoke test, render and post release notes in `#ledgerly-releases` using `ledgerly-release-notes-v3`. Keep commits small.

## Recent work: a short narrative of what was done recently and what is still relevant.

Optimized `invoice_summary.py` by replacing per-currency invoice queries with one aggregate query per account and batching minor-unit conversion. Tenant 73 now uses 37 queries, returns the same 14,802 aggregates, and profiles at 4.46 seconds. Added a stable 37-query regression assertion; 18 summary tests, Ruff, and all 63 report tests passed (2 PostgreSQL skips).

Avatar migration steps 1–5 are complete: 18,432 files indexed with SHA-256, run record inserted, files uploaded to S3, and sample object verification succeeded.

Invoice PDF baseline is `12 passed, 1 skipped in 1.84s`. `ledgerly/billing/pdf.py::render_invoice()` delegates to `_format_lines()` and uses a two-page canvas. Seven call sites were found. Renderer work has not yet begun. Keep commits small and paste exact test output rather than paraphrasing.
